description: A single area with a gradient fill, dots on each point and a value axis on the right.
overview: One series drawn as a monotone curve with a fill that fades from top to bottom, a dot on every month, a month axis below and a four-tick value axis on the right. The tooltip follows your finger across the plot.
usage: Replace `chartData` with your records and change each `dataKey` to match your fields. Set the label and color in `chartConfig`, and adjust `tickCount` on the `YAxis` to change how many values it shows. The component takes no props.
